source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. To check Quiet Boot option is Enables or Disabled, the default setting is [Enable]

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. All bootable devices should be shown in Boot Option
2. Boot sequence should be set successfully
3. System should follow the boot sequence correctly

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Quiet Boot: Quiet Boot toggles the POST logo/output; verifying it needs the operator to change it in the BIOS Boot page and observe the boot screen at the console.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator captures the boot screen with Quiet Boot on/off; agent cannot observe the console during POST.

original_test_intent: Unresolved: Items and Procedure identify Quiet Boot state/default behavior, while every Criterion evaluates bootable-device visibility, boot-sequence configuration and following the sequence.
original_method: After correction, either perform a manual Quiet Boot state/POST-presentation check or execute a controlled Boot Option Priority device/order matrix; do not combine evidence from the two functions.
manual_activity: If Quiet Boot is selected, a human must observe POST presentation; if boot order is selected, a human must configure/observe controlled media. The agent cannot choose the scope from contradictory source fields.
required_inputs: Quiet Boot expected logo/text behavior or boot-device/order matrix
safety_requirements: Do not change Quiet Boot or boot order while scope is unresolved.
Never use boot-order evidence to pass Quiet Boot or a POST logo to pass boot-order behavior.
After correction, approve any save/reset and boot media before execution.
Keep BMC/OOB recovery and stop on unexpected media selection or boot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only BIOS identity, current Quiet Boot state, boot entries/order and health.
After correction, organize only scope-matched evidence and inspect the project script.
Do not infer the target function or issue the verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the matching expected behavior, evidence and recovery plan.
Perform the required BIOS/POST interaction and decide PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its manual Quiet Boot explanation fits Items/Procedure but not the boot-order Criteria; it cannot be accepted until scope is resolved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Do not add or run a command. After correction, review the preserved quiet_boot script only for Quiet Boot scope; use boot-order tools only if the owner selects that distinct scope.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Default Enable, script URL and 10/10-minute fields are preserved along with all three contradictory Criteria.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For Quiet Boot, capture Enabled/Disabled POST presentation; for Boot Option Priority, record the full entry/order matrix and controlled selected-device boot. Select exactly one after correction.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, console and relevant script/tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-corrected source and platform Boot-page specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Separates the two conflated functions without guessing which is authoritative.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Boot-order changes can select unsafe/unintended media; Quiet Boot changes only presentation and cannot prove ordering.

project_override_considerations: Project parameters can define devices, order or visual expectations after the master target is resolved; they cannot silently convert a Quiet Boot case into Boot Option Priority or vice versa.
expected_evidence: Engineer verdict separated from tool result

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Quiet Boot controls POST logo/output presentation, whereas the Criteria require enumeration and execution of boot priority. They are distinct functions and one result cannot satisfy both.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The acceptance target is genuinely ambiguous. Executing either interpretation would discard the other source facts and could alter boot selection.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its silent preference for the item/procedure over Criteria.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with SOURCE_CONFLICT/BLOCKED and retains strict function/evidence separation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds a scoped engineering decision, readiness boundaries and no-substitution gate.

review_improvement: Prevents Quiet Boot screenshots from falsely passing boot-order behavior and prevents boot-device changes from being introduced into a presentation-only case without authority.
independent_technical_reasoning: The mismatch is not a missing expected value: it changes the controlled firmware function and evidence type. V3.1 therefore requires a source conflict and execution block pending owner correction.
no_automatic_retry: No state change or retry is allowed until the function is resolved; afterward preserve the first mismatch and obtain engineer disposition.
